name: Antiky Generative Contract Component Catalog
purpose: Registry of namespaced component and relationship types used by generative entity-component graph contracts.

mergePolicies.replace: The child payload replaces the inherited payload.
mergePolicies.deep-merge: Objects merge recursively; scalar values replace inherited scalars; arrays replace unless the component schema defines keyed merge behavior.
mergePolicies.append-unique: Arrays append values while preserving stable order and uniqueness.
mergePolicies.non-inheritable: The component may not flow from a parent or prototype.

description.intent.description: Human and agent-facing statement of purpose, first read, emotional target, and required close-detail reads.
invalidates: none by itself unless a policy chooses to treat intent changes as full-scene invalidation

core.bounds.description: Physical or canonical extent. All world-space dimensions use meters; voxel counts are quality hints.

style.visualLanguage.description: Scene-level visual grammar and explicit anti-style boundaries.

style.detailProfile.description: Required detail at macro, meso, and micro scales for a prototype or scene element.

style.forbiddenForms.description: Named structural anti-patterns that generation and validation must reject.

generation.policy.description: Controls whether derived entities may be edited, what scope regenerates, and how stable identity is preserved.

validation.acceptance.description: Scene-level declaration of required validation suites and human approval policy.

validation.metricTargets.description: Prototype or entity-local metric thresholds. Keys are metric IDs and values are threshold records.
invalidates: validation only unless a generator consumes targets for optimization

environment.skyProfile.description: Sky illumination and horizon conditions independent of a concrete renderer.

environment.lightingProfile.description: Semantic key, ambient, occlusion, shadow, and tone-mapping intent.

environment.windField.description: World wind direction and shelter/deposition behavior used by snow, grass, and young vegetation.

terrain.heightfield.description: Layered terrain shape grammar. Algorithm IDs resolve to versioned engine implementations.

terrain.surfaceLayers.description: Semantic surface layers and condition-based coverage ranges.

terrain.snowField.description: Base ground-snow depth and shaping policy before local obstacles are applied.

terrain.landformModifier.description: Region-scoped offset or multiplier applied to a base terrain and environment field.

terrain.surfaceOverride.description: Region-scoped override for snow, ground exposure, or semantic surface coverage.

layout.regionMask.description: Authored or generated spatial mask used for terrain, population, and composition constraints.

layout.clearance.description: Asset exclusion and occupancy policy for a protected region.

layout.anchor.description: Authored reservation or selection point that a composition system resolves to a generated instance or region.

composition.populationRole.description: Scene-level role and screen-space limits for a population.

composition.screenTarget.description: Screen-space target for a selected subject or protected region.

composition.frame.description: Foreground framing target tied to a camera and one or more source populations.

composition.depthBand.description: Required population and atmosphere characteristics across a camera depth range.

ecology.layerProfile.description: Vertical and horizontal coverage goals for an ecological layer.

population.prototypeMix.description: Weighted prototypes available to a population.

population.quantity.description: Count or density target and the scope at which it is sampled.

population.distribution.description: Algorithm identifier plus spatial, cluster, terrain, mask, and relationship parameters.

population.variation.description: Population-level seed stream, correlations, and uniqueness requirements.
invalidates: population instance parameters and synthesized assets

variation.parameters.description: Prototype parameter distributions sampled at a declared scope.

geometry.treeGrammar.description: Trunk, branch, crown, and foliage-volume grammar for tree prototypes.

geometry.shrubGrammar.description: Stem, fork, lobe, burial, and obstacle-response grammar for shrubs.

geometry.grassGrammar.description: Blade cluster count, lean, spread, breakage, and snow-clump grammar.

geometry.rockGrammar.description: Fracture, aspect ratio, burial, weathering, and edge-shape grammar.

geometry.logGrammar.description: Centerline, broken ends, bark loss, branch stubs, and burial grammar.

geometry.twigGrammar.description: Twig count, length, diameter, crossing, and snow burial grammar.

material.assignment.description: Maps semantic geometry slots to semantic material definitions.

surface.snowReceiver.description: Snow adhesion, exposure, occlusion, wind, overhang, and edge rules for generated geometry.
invalidates: surface snow geometry and snow validation

detail.attachments.description: Counts, probabilities, and visibility policy for meso and micro attachments.

render.camera.description: Stable camera or target-selection definition for beauty and diagnostic renders.

render.outputPasses.description: Required beauty and diagnostic render passes.

composition.frames.description: A source population, camera, or anchor frames a target region or subject.

composition.anchors.description: An authored anchor selects or reserves a generated instance from a population.

composition.preservesNegativeSpace.description: A camera or population must preserve a protected opening.

composition.softensBoundary.description: A population creates an irregular transition around a region boundary.

composition.breaksMass.description: A contrasting population breaks the repeated value or silhouette mass of another.

composition.selectsFrom.description: A framing or focal anchor selects candidate instances from a population.

composition.fillsDepthBand.description: A population is responsible for occupancy and rhythm in a depth band.

ecology.spawnsNear.description: A population is sampled near instances from another population.

ecology.spawnsFrom.description: A population represents debris, offspring, or secondary effects associated with another population.

ecology.growsUnder.description: A population prefers the canopy, dripline, or shelter field of another population.

ecology.clustersWith.description: Two populations have a local positive spatial association.

environment.influencedByWindField.description: A population uses a wind field for orientation or density.

environment.influences.description: An environment entity influences entities selected by a component or tag query.

surface.createsSnowObstacle.description: Generated instances alter local ground-snow scouring, deposition, or contact compression.

derivedComponentConvention.authoringRule: Derived components may be read but not directly authored. A persistent correction must be expressed as a source contract patch.
